text: @bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail 是面向 DSH 网页客户端的逐回复技能与工具轨迹插件。它由宿主端把会话日志中的工具调用和结果折叠为每轮数据，并由浏览器客户端在每条回复下方的 turnTail 区域显示技能、已用工具及失败状态。它还能从当前会话快照生成轨迹，并在数据源异常时显示诊断信息。适合想查看每轮实际触发了哪些技能和工具的 DSH 用户。需要宿主提供 sessionProjections 服务以及网页聊天界面的 turnTail 插槽；代码未配置外部 API 或密钥。

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail shows per-turn skills and tools beneath DSH replies. The host folds tool calls and results into trail data; the browser marks successful and failed tools. It needs sessionProjections and the web chat turnTail slot; no API key is configured.

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) plugin
that renders a compact trail under every assistant reply: which **skills were
triggered** (🧠) and which **tools were actually used** (✓) or failed (✗).

```
🧩 技能軌跡  [🧠 ak-hk-stock-dd ✓]  [read ×3 ✓]  [bash ×2 ✓]  [web_search ✗]
```

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Why it is truthful：The badges are **not** produced by the model. A `skillTrail` session-projection
unit (Host) folds each session's **committed log** — every `tool/call` event
becomes a triggered entry; the paired `tool/result` (matched by `callId`)
settles it as `ok` / `err`. The Client reads the finished value through
`useProjection('skillTrail')` and renders it in the zero-risk
`conversation.chat.turnTail` slot.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Why it is truthful：- ✅ Structural — the platform records, nobody self-reports
- ✅ Replayable — projection folds are pure; persisted cache + cold-start
  backfill come from the DSH projection subsystem for free
- ✅ Per-turn — each reply shows exactly its own turn's trail
- ✅ Skill-aware — `skill` tool calls render as 🧠 with the resolved skill name

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Install：The package ships a Host half (`lib/index.js`) and a browser Client half
(`lib/client.js`, `window.__ModuleLoader__` closure-factory format).

section: Path A — Host composition (always-on, every session & preset)

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Path B — Agent preset：Add one row to your preset's `agent.cordis.yml` (a consumer-only row — it
publishes no service, so it sits loose; no `isolate` realm needed):

```yaml
- id: skill-trail
  name: '@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail'
```

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Path C — Dynamic experiment：Inside a session, `@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail` can also be run through the
dynamic Cordis flow; prefer A or B for anything standing.

@bryan-cmf/dsh-skill-trail README · Configuration：| Key | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `maxTurns` | `500` | Turns retained per session; oldest pruned first |
| `maxCallsPerTurn` | `50` | Triggered-entry cap per turn (wire-payload guard) |
